cds.title: Indiana University Indianapolis Common Data Set 2025-2026 (IU Institutional Analytics CDS app, campus IU-Indianapolis, year 2025, section C)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (Fall 2025 first-time first-year, IU Indianapolis campus): 16,460 applied, 12,846 admitted (78%). International: 625 applied, 350 admitted (56%), 19 enrolled, so international applicants are admitted far less often than domestic ones. No early decision; no waitlist. C9: 28.5% of enrolled students submitted SAT (918), 2.4% ACT (78). IU Indianapolis was created in 2024 when IUPUI was split; every figure here is the IU Indianapolis Fall 2025 CDS, no IUPUI-era figure is used. C7 factor checkboxes could not be read reliably from the text and are omitted. Undergraduate enrollment and intl_undergrads are the B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures (14,834; nonresident 273 including non-degree students).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8F: IU Indianapolis has a test-optional admission policy; the applicant decides at application whether SAT or ACT scores are considered.

cost.notes: CDS G1 first-year 2026-27: in-state tuition $9,518, out-of-state $33,983 (international students pay the out-of-state rate), required fees $1,244, on-campus food and housing $13,656; G5 books $1,290. The international office estimates $36,110 tuition and fees (incl. the $331/year international services fee) and $56,258 total for 9 months. H6: 117 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $12,369; the need-based/non-need-based checkboxes in H6 are ambiguous in the text, so intl_need_aid is left unset.
